messages.text:
Cacio e pepe — five ingredients, twenty minutes, deeply satisfying.

Boil 8 oz of spaghetti in well-salted water. While it cooks, toast a heaping teaspoon of cracked black pepper in a dry pan for 30 seconds. Reserve a cup of pasta water before draining. Add the pasta to the pan with a splash of the starchy water, then off heat fold in a generous handful of finely grated Pecorino Romano. Toss vigorously until it forms a glossy sauce. Add more pasta water if it tightens up. Serve immediately.

That's it.
